quotes.quote: The agent-loop tests introduced in #1327 reject valid conversations: a model may request Paris and London weather on separate turns, and a final answer may contain an empty tool-call list.

This behavior already exists on `main`: the test requests sequential calls but does not assert their order. Adding strict sequencing coverage is outside this PR’s scope. We’ve renamed the test to better reflect what it actually verifies.

Treat an empty `tool_calls` list as a final response.

`ChatCompletionMessage.tool_calls` permits both `None` and `[]`. When it is `[]`, `_run_agent_loop` skips the final-response branch and can continue until the iteration-limit assertion.
